note: custom_field_media adds one Custom Field widget, media_library_widget (class MediaLibraryWidget extends EntityReferenceWidgetBase, category Media, field_types ['entity_reference']), applicable only when the Custom Field entity_reference column's target_type is 'media'. Per-column widget config lives at core.entity_form_display.<...>.content.<field>.settings.fields.<column>.type = 'media_library_widget' with optional settings.fields.<column>.media_types (sequence of allowed media type IDs). The column is a normal custom_field entity_reference column with target_type: media in the field storage columns setting. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config on a namespaced content type cfmedia_eval with field_cfmedia_* fields (created by setup/reset, removed by cleanup). No Views are created (a broken module on this site fatals Views handler discovery).

evals.prompt: In the custom_field_media submodule, what is the machine name of the widget it provides, and on what kind of Custom Field column can it be used?
evals.expected_output: It provides the media_library_widget ('Media library') widget, usable on a Custom Field entity_reference column whose target_type is media.

evals.prompt: Which subfield (column) type must a Custom Field column be, and referencing which entity type, for the custom_field_media 'Media library' widget to be available?
evals.expected_output: The column must be a custom_field entity_reference type with target_type set to media; isApplicable() only returns true when getTargetType() === 'media'.

evals.prompt: How do you restrict which media bundles an editor can pick with the custom_field_media Media library widget, and where is that stored?
evals.expected_output: Set the widget's media_types setting (a sequence of allowed media type IDs, in display order; empty means all allowed). It is stored on the form-display component at settings.fields.<column>.media_types, a schema key added to custom_field.field.* by hook_config_schema_info_alter().

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Custom Field field_cfmedia_wid on the 'cfmedia_eval' content type has its 'image' column configured on the default form display. Inspect the live configuration and state which widget that column uses.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.cfmedia_eval.default the field_cfmedia_wid component's settings.fields.image.type is media_library_widget (with media_types ['image']).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Custom Field field_cfmedia_ref on 'cfmedia_eval' has an entity_reference column named 'asset'. Inspect the live field storage and state which entity type that column references.
evals.expected_output: In field.storage.node.field_cfmedia_ref the 'asset' column is type entity_reference with target_type: media.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Custom Field field_cfmedia_disp on content type 'cfmedia_eval' has an entity_reference(media) column 'image' currently edited with an autocomplete widget. Using custom_field_media, reconfigure the default form display so that the 'image' column uses the Media library widget instead. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.cfmedia_eval.default the field_cfmedia_disp component has settings.fields.image.type = media_library_widget.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a content type 'cfmedia_eval'. Create a Custom Field named field_cfmedia_task on it that has an entity_reference column which references media entities (so the custom_field_media Media library widget could later be used on it). Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: field.storage.node.field_cfmedia_task is a custom field whose columns include an entity_reference column with target_type: media, instanced on cfmedia_eval.
